name: SRL-2018 Remote Desktop Server RD-06 — Memory Forensics
description: Volatility3 memory analysis. 0 LOTL processes + code injection in 4 processes. Minimal compromise — payload deployed but no active C2 at acquisition time. Likely a propagation target at the periphery of the attack.

artifacts.description: vol3 windows.malfind: code injection in 4 processes (PIDs: 3996, 112, 400, 00). PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE regions. Windows 10 Enterprise. No LOTL processes detected via pslist — payload dormant or beacon

forensic_anomalies: 4 injected processes with PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE — same shellcode signature as all other compromised SRL-2018 hosts
Absence of active LOTL despite 4 injections: beacon may be in long sleep (hours/days) at 2018-09-07 acquisition time, or active LOTL terminated between infection and snapshot
Low injection count (4) vs other RD servers (12-43) positions RD-06 as peripheral propagation target — attacker allocated minimal resources to this host
